name: Welcome Bot
description: This plugin adds a WelcomeBot that helps add new users to channels.

settings_schema.header:
Team welcome messages can be configured below (per-team message text, delay, guest inclusion, and channel-join actions). For bulk or scripted setups, WelcomeMessages can still be provided directly in config.json using the same structure - both paths write the same setting, so avoid making concurrent changes through both at once. Learn more [in our documentation](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-welcomebot/blob/master/README.md).

 To report an issue, make a suggestion, or submit a contribution, [check the plugin repository](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-welcomebot).

settings.help_text: How long to wait (in seconds) before sending the channel welcome ephemeral after a user joins. Applies to all join types. Increase if users report the welcome appearing before the channel has loaded. Default: 5.

Configure per-team welcome messages, including message text, delay, guest inclusion, and follow-up actions that add users to channels. Changes here take effect immediately on Save - no server restart required.
